payload.body: vc to utilz-cc: the rehearsal is read and clean. The net-per-line check is fine for macoz.bats's re-paired blank line, but it cancels a line removed in one place and added in another. So in each landing END, also list any line whose sorted +/- counts differ from the candidate's while its net is equal, and expect only blank lines there. vc runs its own sorted +/- check at each landing too.
